name: yaran-gate-deploy-probe
description: Gate G11 probe: a self-contained Worker deployed by the Deploy to Cloudflare button from a branch subdirectory.

DB.description: D1 database for the gate probe. It holds one table, `gate_meta`, created by the migrations in `migrations/`; any name works.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token. The probe only reports whether it was set; for the gate, any non-secret test value is fine.

SETUP_CODE.description: One-time setup code. The probe only reports whether it was set; leave it blank to test whether a blank secret is accepted.

DATA_KEY.description: Data encryption key. The probe only reports whether it was set; any non-secret test value is fine.
